comment: Written BEFORE any code reads FIELDS (the W discipline). v0.34 is COMPASS-KERN-03's field check: an ASK may name where the schema of the kind asked lives, FIELDS seat.seat, and the forged court's ask verb then refuses a WHERE or ORDER BY that names a field the declaration does not declare. The module docstring of gen_fixtures.py states the finding the rung started from (the world declared no schema) and the divergence from zing. A1-A3 accept; R1-R7 refuse, each by the fragment of why. A2 pins that nothing existing changes.

accepts.name: FIELDS records.fields: a seat of the kind asked that refers to a declaration, and a list of name: type pairs of that declaration
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE q AS (VERSION "0.34", GRAMMAR "0.34", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".q") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE EXPRESSION zexpr AS (OPERATORS [or, and, not, cmp, contains, add, sub, mul, div, round, neg], OPERANDS [number, text, flag, ref, agg], AGGREGATES [sum, count], ABSENT missing, DIVISION calm, EQUALITY value) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE FORM field AS (SEATS [name: name, type: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION entity AS (VERB "ENTITY", SEATS [fields: [field]]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION flow AS (VERB "FLOW", SEATS [records: entity?]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE ASK questions AS (FROM [flow], WHERE zexpr, CLAUSES [where, order, limit], FIELDS records.fields) RATIONALE "x"
